context: A uni student interviews a retired historian on famous figures
purpose: Teach: 中田/渡辺/山口/井上/池田/堀江/橋本/岡田

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間ありがとうございます。早速ですが、戦後の政治家で最も印象に残っているのは池田元総理でしょうか。
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. To start, would you say Prime Minister Ikeda left the strongest impression among postwar politicians?
lines.style: Polite university interviewer opening with respectful tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだね。池田さんの所得倍増計画は本当に画期的だった。後の時代に出てきた橋本元首相とはまた違う型の指導者だったよ。
lines.en: Yes indeed. Ikeda's income-doubling plan was truly revolutionary. He was a different type of leader from former Prime Minister Hashimoto, who came along in a later era.
lines.style: Reflective elder voice with measured nostalgic delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。文化人ではいかがでしょう。例えば俳優や作家で記憶に残る方はいますか。
lines.en: I see. What about cultural figures? Are there actors or writers who stand out in your memory?
lines.style: Curious follow-up question by a young researcher.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 作家なら井上先生の作品をよく読んだものだ。それから歴史小説では渡辺さんという編集者にも随分お世話になったよ。
lines.en: For writers, I often read Professor Inoue's works. And in historical fiction, an editor named Watanabe was very helpful to me.
lines.style: Warm storytelling tone recalling personal connections.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スポーツ界の伝説的な人物についてもお聞きしたいです。中田選手の活躍はご覧になりましたか。
lines.en: I would also like to ask about legendary figures in sports. Did you watch Nakata's achievements on the field?
lines.style: Engaged question shifting topic with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろん見たよ。中田選手のプレーは本当に芸術的だった。試合中継では山口さんの落ち着いた解説も毎回楽しみにしていたなあ。
lines.en: Of course I watched. Nakata's play was truly artistic. During the broadcasts, I always looked forward to Mr. Yamaguchi's calm commentary as well.
lines.style: Animated elder speech showing genuine sports enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実業家ではどなたが印象的でしたか。堀江社長のような新しい世代の経営者についてはどう思われますか。
lines.en: Which businesspeople left an impression on you? What do you think about new-generation entrepreneurs like President Horie?
lines.style: Probing question comparing generational business leaders with curiosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 堀江さんは確かに型破りだったね。私の時代だと、地道に町工場を育てた岡田さんという経営者がどうしても忘れられないなあ。
lines.en: Horie was certainly unconventional. In my era, I simply cannot forget an executive named Okada who patiently built up his small factory.
lines.style: Contemplative comparison with affectionate older-generation pride.
